task: Find a Coursera course on Sustainable Agriculture practices, and detail the course's objectives and the background of the lead instructor.
answer:
Course: Sustainable Agricultural Land Management (University of Florida) on Coursera (https://www.coursera.org/learn/sustainable-agriculture).

COURSE OBJECTIVES: The course covers agricultural and urban water quality issues in Florida, their bases, land and nutrient management strategies, and the science and policy behind best management practices (BMPs). Students will learn to evaluate BMP research and analyze its role in determining practices and policies that protect water quality. Skills gained include Environmental Issues, Water Resource Management, Water Resources, Environmental Regulations, Water Quality, and Land Management.

LEAD INSTRUCTOR BACKGROUND: George J. Hochmuth, Ph.D. - Professor at the University of Florida. He leads the Research Program in Urban and Agricultural Fertilization and Nutrient Management Practices. His research addresses environmental science questions about water quality and nutrient (especially nitrogen and phosphorus) and water management in urban and agricultural settings, including nutrient budgets in groundwater/surface water, alternative water sources for irrigation, efficient irrigation technologies, and improved water management practices to protect Florida's water quality.
